steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: This Feline woman is not some no-name.

options: But she still was no match for you.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Don't worry. Her henchmen were mediocre at best. After ensuring your safety, it was a fairly simple matter for me to retreat.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: However, I might know a thing or two about the identity of that bodyguard.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Columbian, Feline, female, silver hair, amber eyes, and a black crossbow. She's both a mercenary and an assassin.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: For a hitman, being famous is nothing to be proud of, but the truth is that her feats were simply too astonishing.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: For example, she once wiped out an entire clan in Columbia. It was a powerful clan as well. Gradually, over a few years, its important figures met violent ends one after another until the entire clan crumbled into nothingness.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Another example - she once hunted down an entire patrol group. This patrol was notorious for killing people at Columbia's border. Calling themselves 'Conquerors of the Barbarians,' their violence towards other races brought about many tragedies.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: After a single month, they fled into the mountains but were slain left and right until only one member, disabled and incoherent, managed to make it back to the city.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The last example is the man who told me these stories.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I'll get to the point. He has a scar going from his left shoulder to his right heel.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Cold-blooded killers are abound here, and I'm one of them.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Of course, this particular woman has been missing for some time.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: But if my hunch is correct, and they're the same person, then things are about to get real ugly.

options: The waters here are a lot murkier than I expected.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The mayor might not be blind to all of this.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: As a matter of fact, I wouldn't even be surprised if the mayor was the one who hired her.
(Glass shatters)

options: How long have you been here...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Miss Ceylon, you don't have to eavesdrop.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I... I just wanted to get some water for you...

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Mister Hellagur, when did that mercenary begin her career, and when did she go missing?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: She had made a name for herself even before I was discharged.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: As for when she disappeared, I'd say about a year ago, after that clan was annihilated.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: ...Schwarz had been taking care of me, up until six years ago.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: But one day, she suddenly told me my father needed her for something, and just left. After that, I only saw her when she'd pick me up over Christmas.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: B-but, I'm sure she was just in a bad mood, plus she was just following orders. There's no way she's a cold-blooded killer!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Furthermore, are you implying that my father is somehow behind Cronin's actions?!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I don't believe it!

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: I won't jump to conclusions. However, I must remind you that even the people you trust most cannot solely look out for your interests.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Whether she trusts you or not is none of my concern. All I know is, I would never mistake those scars inflicted by Ursine weapons. The squad that did that to her are now buried deep underneath the snow.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: The situation should be clear to you, Doctor.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: If the City Council also has a hand in circulating false information about the volcano, then we should stay out of this.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Miss Ceylon, you should also try to see the truth.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I... I need to calm down.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Doctor, if you would.

options: Something that only I can do, huh?

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Naturally. She needs someone who can understand her.
